title: Make venue-aware formatting Agent-first and template-first
description: Uses the lightweight venue-writing brief during formatting and keeps deterministic template/LaTeX checks at finalization without adding a workflow service.
changes: Read planning/venue-writing-brief.md when present before drafting or exporting.
Use official template evidence before writing venue-specific LaTeX.
Keep unknown requirements explicit and do not silently switch to generic article.
Treat arc_latex_check severity as the final deterministic formatting signal.

rollback.notes: Restore the prior formatting guidance if the brief convention is not adopted.
